title: A finite threshold for the double-comet conjecture
summary: For a tree $T$, let $g(T)=λ_1(T)-λ_2(T)$ be the difference between its two largest adjacency eigenvalues. A balanced double comet is obtained by attaching equally many leaves to the two endpoints of a path. Jovović, Koledin and Stanić conjectured that such a tree attains the minimum adjacency spectral gap among trees of any fixed order. We prove that every minimizing tree of order $n\ge200$ is a balanced double comet.
